### Pull Request Approval Checklist

- [ ] Make sure IaC changes make sense
- [ ] IaC changes has no impact on already deployed infrastructure.
- [ ] Relevant document/readme is added/updated
- [ ] Code contains no vulnerability issue. Validate corresponding Jenkins stage
- [ ] InSpec test cases are added/updated
- [ ] Example code is added/updated
- [ ] Pipeline is Successful
